scope: Independent read-only mathematical/source/result/hash review; no numerical rerun.
checks: The exact positive-part integral handles same-sign, opposite-sign and zero endpoint cases; adding L*(g_plus-g_minus)*I_plus to the supporting dot gives the full native first variation.
Trials require the upper directional interval endpoint to be negative; a negative support dot alone does not pass.
Normalizing by the norm upper endpoint is conservative. Both controls fix endpoints and check the original box and nonzero trial segments.
For positive c and step, new_action.upper <= old_action.lower + c*step*D.lower implies the actual Armijo inequality and strict action decrease.
Actions integrate the reciprocal-affine profile with exact rational enclosures at exact rational trial coordinates; approximate decimal displays are not used as authoritative coordinates.
Both accepted steps retain the original failed local flag. Their larger new support-norm bounds are reported and do not establish an optimization or stationarity result.
limitations: Only two independent single steps from the same fixed native polygon; no iterative solver, new stationary-path/source derivative or production change.
No inserted-knot, general trilinear-medium or global first-arrival result follows.
